sonnet.problem: The direction of prayer toward the chosen city and the temple was already told in card 1 (8:44) and repeated in card 2's question. Verse 48 repeats that line from 8:44, so asking about it here gives away the answer and re-asks a fact that was already covered.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.

sonnet.problem: The statement says captive Israel is 'far off' in an enemy's land. Verse 46 says the captors take them 'whether far or near', so 'far off' stretches the text.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
